property_summary: For every call to transfer, since the reference requires each low-level call to succeed, routing c through a callee whose transferFrom reverts makes transfer revert; the mutant inverts the success condition, so the same reverting callee makes transfer return true, and the test observes that the reference address's call reverted by checking the call result flag.
change_summary: Change the required success condition from require(_s) to require(!_s), inverting when transfer reverts.
